name: evaluation index system for the training quality of gastroenterology specialist nurses
description: ObjectiveTo establish the evaluation index system for the training quality of gastroenterology specialist nurses,so as to provide a scientific basis for improving the training effectiveness of gastroenterology specialist nurses.MethodsBased on the CIPP evaluation model as the theoretical basis,the initial draft of the evaluation index system for the training quality of gastroenterology specialist nurses was formulated through literature search and semi⁃structured interviews.Then,the Delphi expert consultation and analytic hierarchy process were used to finally determine the training quality evaluation index system for gastroenterology specialist nurses and the weights of each level of indicators.ResultsTwo rounds of expert consultation were conducted.The effective recovery rates of the questionnaires were 95% and 100%,respectively.The expert authority coefficients were 0.895 and 0.919,respectively.The Kendall coefficient of concordance in the second round of expert consultation ranged from 0.149 to 0.496(all P<0.05).The coefficient of variation ranged from 0.000 to 0.232.The final evaluation index system for the training quality of gastroenterology specialist nurses included 4 first⁃level indicators,14 second⁃level indicators,and 39 third⁃level indicators.ConclusionsThe evaluation index system for the training quality of gastroenterology specialist nurses is scientific and feasible.It could objectively and systematically evaluate the training quality of gastroenterology speci…
